situation: How many cache layers and where to put them.
decision: Use several tiers: L1 in-process memory in each MCP pod, L2 node-local NVMe/SSD (DaemonSet), L3 regional distributed cache, L4 durable object/blob/vector storage.
reasoning_physics: Each tier optimizes a different cost: L1 for zero-latency hits, L2 for node affinity, L3 for cross-node reuse, L4 for durability/recovery. A single-tier cache is either too fast to be durable or too durable to be fast.
